description: Runs of Code Engine builds. start runs a build configuration; get shows status; logs and events show why it failed. Identify a run with project_id and build_run_name. Call get_schema with name ce_build_run for every action's fields.

action.description: start: Start a run of build_name; build_run_name optionally names the run. Needs build_name. | list: List build runs. | get: Get status of one run: pending, running, succeeded, or failed. Needs build_run_name. | logs: Get the build output (kept only briefly after it finishes). Needs build_run_name. | events: Get platform events such as clone or push failures. Needs build_run_name.

build_name.description: Name of the build configuration to run

build_run_name.description: Build run name, from ce_build_run action list.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return per container (default: 200)

name: ce_build_run
